note: Expected dispositions cover scenario routing, not verified authenticity, execution or production performance.

scenarios.purpose: Complete structured instruction with distinct valid lines.
Preserve the EUR amount without converting it to units.
Missing economic terms require client clarification.
A failing ISIN checksum blocks readiness. Never apply a suggested correction.
Simulated authentication failure and unknown sender.
An identical earlier instruction needs verification before treating it as new.
The sale exceeds the sample available position.
Late arrival needs timing review, without promising next-day execution.
Unknown accounts cannot pass by skipping account-specific checks.
The configured fictional restricted instrument prevents readiness.
Negative units are invalid even in a structured template.
Unsupported directions must not fall through into the buy branch.
Headers without order rows cannot produce a ready order.
Mixed free-text instructions must not combine unrelated fields.
The combined indicative purchase value exceeds available cash.
Individually affordable sale lines jointly exceed the available position.
Negation and hypothetical wording cannot become a live instruction.
An unreadable workbook becomes an exception without stopping the batch.
